nom: MEDITHERAPY Retinal Skin Booster Serum 5.07 fl oz

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports the serum worked well without excessive irritation, refined her pores and gradually faded acne marks; another describes skin that was dry yet somehow oily becoming balanced and moisturized.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or very dry skin, including some in their 40s and 50s, report the serum left their skin smooth, glowing and hydrated within one to two weeks.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination (often combination-sensitive) skin report negative experiences: stickiness that worsens in heat, and tightness, dryness or irritation after a few days of use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation, redness or breakouts even with allergy-prone or rosacea-affected skin, while others (including combination-sensitive skin) report stinging, tightness or new breakouts; one reviewer who says her skin is NOT acne-prone or sensitive still developed a cystic pimple after a single use.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin and few wrinkles reports plumper, softer skin with visibly lessening fine lines after a few weeks.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 70s report smoother texture, reduced fine lines and wrinkles, and improved firmness, with some calling the change dramatic; one long-time retin-A user in her 70s instead had a bad breakout and did not repurchase.

concerns.aging: Reviewers targeting fine lines, wrinkles and firmness report visible smoothing and lifting, in some cases within days to a couple of weeks, describing skin as plumper and more youthful; one reviewer, however, says the product does not reduce wrinkles or spots and only gives slight, temporary hydration.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers report the serum leaves skin soft, plump and hydrated, including some with dry or dry-sensitive skin; a few instead describe stickiness that requires layering a moisturizer on top, or skin that felt tight, dry and under-moisturized.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including one with long-standing rosacea, report reduced redness and blotchiness with no burning; others report the opposite, describing extreme facial irritation, burning, or an allergic reaction, particularly when combined with sunscreen.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers using it for dark spots, melasma or sun damage report gradual fading, typically visible after three to eight weeks of consistent use; several others report zero change in their dark or age spots even after several weeks to two months.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: some reviewers, including one with acne-prone skin, say it prevents new breakouts and fades old acne marks, while several others describe new cystic pimples, clogged pores or breakouts appearing within days of starting use, including in reviewers who do not normally react to actives.
concerns.oiliness: Material is thin, but reviewers with skin described as oily (including dry-yet-oily skin) report it left their skin moisturized rather than greasy, without addressing oil control directly.

aspects.libelle: Feels sticky or tacky for some users
Large bottle, strong value for the price
Packaging arrives without a seal or with a broken pump

extraits.texte: Like most of us I was wooed by the Instagram ad with the dramatic results, then saw the mountains of 5 star reviews and the weirdly low price. I ordered it, and during shipment I clicked on the one-star reviews out of curiosity. It was alarming all the reports of "cystic acne" and I thought gosh that doesn't sound nice at all! So when I got the stuff, I used it on one part of my face as a test. One single night, literally, and the next morning I had a huge hard pimple... I guess of the "cystic" variety. I don't have acne-prone or sensitive skin, so I was kind of shocked by this. Wondering about all those glowing reviews saying this is literally the best thing ever? Well... Shady stuff happens on the Internet. I dunno .. this stuff has a trillion ingredients that are gnarly chemicals and I'm going back to my natural skincare with TruSkin hyaluronic acid serum and Terra Lotus beef tallow balm. These things come from the earth and leave my skin feeling great.

This is a big disappoint NO from me. In my 70's and my acne days have been behind me for a very long time. I am also a very long time user of retin-a and retinol products and never had a reaction like this! Two days and my face is still recovering from the breakout. Will try using on legs so I am not out my money and hopefully will not get a reaction. Definitely will not be purchasing again!
Have been using a few days and my sensitive combination skin is starting to feel tight and dry. Little irritated. Doesn't feel moisturized like I had expected. Will keep you posted

This K Beauty Retinal Skin Booster by Meditherapy is one of the best skin care products available. It's an absolutely beautiful formula that contains so many of my favorite ingredients from Niacinamide, several variations of Cica, Retinal 100 ppm ( parts per million), Fig, Beta Glucan, and Ceramides to mention just a few. It has a light creamy texture that glides I to the skin and does it's magic The Retinal is listed midway down the ingredients list so it's not overly strong and can probably be tolerated by most skin types due to its gentle nature. My dry sensitive skin loved it and caused me no irritation at all. It leaves my skin looking and feeling soft, bouncy, and moisturized It comes well packaged with an expiration date and ingredients list both in English and Korean. It's a very large bottle at an outstanding price point. This is a huge win with me and I highly recommend it ALWAYS do a patch test 24 hours before using any new skin care products 5 stars

extraits.titre: If you have Rosacea this is a must!!!
extraits.texte: If you have Rosacea this is a MUST!!! I have tried EVERYTHING!!! Up to chemical peels, hydro facials you name it… but nothing seemed to help. Then I started researching. Came across the ingredients that are listed in this bottle and decided to try it. Huge difference!!!!!! Keep it in the refrigerator and use right after you wash and tone your face. This is a game changer for me. I have suffered for YEARS with rosacea that I absolutely hated! The redness, blotchy, muddy appearance was so so embarrassing. After using Selsum blue to wash my face, I use glycolic acid as a toner then use this right out of the refrigerator and it’s heavenly!!! No more muddy, red, irritable skin for me! Just soft and smooth! Highly effective. Hydration and baby soft skin without the sticky feeling! So easy to use. Just a pea size amount goes a long way!

extraits.titre: Absolute game changer for dry, sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I am always incredibly hesitant to try retinal products because my skin is so dry and sensitive, but the Meditherapy Retinal Skin Booster Serum is an absolute game-changer! Thanks to the Centella Asiatica and Niacinamide in the formula, it is incredibly gentle and hasn't caused a single bit of irritation. Instead, it deeply hydrates my skin and leaves it feeling incredibly smooth to the touch. I've already noticed that it noticeably tightens my pores and is actively lightening my dark spots and clearing up my uneven skin tone. My skin looks brighter, feels firmer, and has a healthy, youthful glow. If you have sensitive, dry skin and want a retinal that actually works without the irritation, you need to try this!

extraits.titre: Take years off in less than a month!
extraits.texte: Forget the Botox…use this! I cannot believe the bags and wrinkles on my face look like they’ve been erased My eyes have such a youthful look instead of dark bags. Forehead lines are gone. after 6 weeks of daily application , I’m 71 years young!! Highly recommend.
